child_tool_info.description: Identify candidate functions from the complete returned BV-BRC Homology BLAST hit population, preserving alignments, function assignments, taxa and source measurements.
child_tool_info.instructions: Select the original query and explicit database or supplied reference population. Retain every returned hit, description and HSP, the program and native thresholds, and any hit limit; the returned population is not the complete database. Supply exact query/member mappings and source-backed function, taxon and reference metadata when available. Never infer a function from a hit title or a metadata join from taxon alone. The numerical sheet retains native scores, coordinate correspondence, coverage denominators, duplicate groups, taxonomy and source measurements. Explicit database-population measurements are needed for representation adjustment. Conditional function weights use inspectable parameters; they are not calibrated annotation probabilities. Missing assignments or population data remain missing. Use the existing launch episode and its selected API child for the original Homology assignment; the supplied invocation contract also includes the existing results assignment. The version field distinguishes these two actual commission payloads. Select native blastp, blastn, blastx, tblastn or tblastx and explicit native input/database parameters. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the original application and inputs without submitting. workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload provide separately selected preparation or transfer operations when needed. submit performs the selected start_app2 request and retains its original task identity. Monitoring uses the existing monitor episode and separately selected query_tasks, stdout or stderr observations; logs do not declare execution state, and no polling schedule is prescribed. The results episode can select task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download to acquire the original task manifest and actual output bytes. Preserve original task, Workspace path/UUID and manifest associations. An HTML report, basename or JSON suffix does not identify the numerical format. Declare the actual raw BLAST JSON, transformed Homology JSON or tabular representation and required fields; opaque archives remain unparsed. The bound deterministic parser fills the numerical sheet, and a separate calculator supplies requested quantities during the selected acquisition action. Saved sheets permit explicit recalculation without another service call. Request only the needed numerical fields or conditional distributions through the typed Homology return sources. Full bytes, sheets and components remain retained. Missing inputs become explicit acquisition requirements; partial, failed, unknown and measured zero remain distinct. This library information grants no direct scientific execution and does not establish live service authentication, deployment or annotation correctness.
child_tool_info.name: bvbrc.homology.database_identification

child_tool_info.instructions:
Operation: material.parse

Parse a registered supplied asset under a chosen wrapper interpretation. Preserve valid independent members and exact original custody; evidence never enlarges annotation targets.

Use the actual local binding and its caller-owned resource limits. Read or measure only the assigned operands and explicit received inputs. Reuse retained outputs when the operation is a read; do not treat a read as a new measurement. Preserve native values, coordinate meanings, partial results and actionable failures. Job-specific operations require their original assigned execution.

Use exactly the separately supplied actual input_schema; required operands and allowed values come from that contract. Do not infer another callable, resource or environment from this entry.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.
